messages:
ACME Ops: We're seeing 502s and TLS verify errors to our private endpoint after last night's cert rotation.
ivy_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the domain and a quick openssl/curl snippet? Any mTLS in front?
ACME Ops: Domain: acme-prod.internal-vpc.redwood.example.com (private VPC). No client mTLS.
ACME Ops:
```bash
openssl s_client -showcerts -connect acme-prod.internal-vpc.redwood.example.com:443 -servername acme-prod.internal-vpc.redwood.example.com
# ...
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=acme-prod
   i:/CN=ACME CrossSigned Intermediate
---
[only leaf presented]
---
SSL handshake has read 1756 bytes and written 456 bytes
---
Verify return code: 20 (unable to get local issuer certificate)
```
jordan_se: That looks like the server did not include the intermediate. Are you proxying or doing TLS inspection? Also, does your VPC egress allow outbound to any OCSP responders?
ACME Ops: We have a strict egress allowlist. The openssl output shows an OCSP responder header: http://ocsp.acme-internal.corp/ocsp — that's internal and not reachable from our allowed egress.
samira_sre: FYI we've reproduced this in staging — the CA rotated to a cross-signed intermediate whose AIA points to an internal OCSP URL. Our rotator expected to staple OCSP and include the intermediate; stapling failed because our edge couldn't reach ocsp.acme-internal.corp due to your egress allowlist, and the rotator didn't bundle the cross-signed intermediate by default.
samira_sre: Repro steps we ran:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect acme-prod.internal-vpc.redwood.example.com:443 -showcerts
curl -v https://acme-prod.internal-vpc.redwood.example.com/health
# both show missing intermediate and curl: "SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate"
```
ivy_support: Short-term workarounds:
- Upload the full cert chain (leaf + intermediate) via the Console or our certs API (field: full_chain) so clients get the chain directly.
- Temporarily allowlist ocsp.acme-internal.corp in your VPC egress so our edge can staple OCSP.
- Ask your CA to provide a public AIA or reissue without internal-only OCSP URL.
ACME Ops: Can you upload the chain for us? We're on-call until 04:00 and need it fixed.
samira_sre: We can perform a forced intermediate add for tenant acme-123 if you can't provide the intermediate PEM. Options:
- Paste the intermediate PEM into this thread (we'll upload and reload)
- Permit our egress IP 52.12.34.56 to fetch the intermediate/OCSP
If you choose us, we'll apply a patch to include the cached cross-signed intermediate; expect ~503s during the reload.
eng-bot: deploy job started: rotator/force-add-intermediate for tenant acme-123 (job 98765). ETA ~18 minutes.
ACME Ops: Quick smoke now — curl /health returns 200. Looks like cert chain is served correctly. We'll monitor and patch firewall if needed. Thanks everyone :heart:
